title: Uniform stationary phase with a moving critical point
author: Kouichi Taira; Hiroyoshi Tamori
difficulty_reason: The saddle approaches the vanishing-amplitude endpoint at a parameter-dependent scale. The proof must choose a cutoff, rescale by the moving saddle, and control three regions uniformly in both parameters; a fixed-parameter stationary-phase application does not give the stated extra decay.
